meta.title: AgentBridge — System Architecture
meta.subtitle: Remote Agent Runtime & ChatOps Control Plane
meta.description: System architecture of AgentBridge showing CLI experience, modular ChatOps Apps (Telegram operational, Slack/Discord planned), Control Plane, Local Runtime, and Agent Adapters.

nodes.label:
AgentBridge CLI
(Rich UI / Animated)
nodes.description: Animated developer-tool CLI with startup lifecycle validation, diagnostic panels, and command dispatch.

nodes.label:
Operator
(Telegram)
nodes.description: Authorized Telegram user identified by allowlisted user_id. Sends commands and approves permission requests via inline keyboard callbacks.

nodes.label:
Telegram App
(Operational)
nodes.description: Modular ChatOps integration for Telegram: handles update deduplication, command routing, inline menus, chunking, and secret redaction.

nodes.label:
Slack App
(Planned)
nodes.description: Planned ChatOps integration scaffold for Slack workspace communication.

nodes.label:
Discord App
(Planned)
nodes.description: Planned ChatOps integration scaffold for Discord guild communication.

nodes.label:
ControlPlane
(FastAPI / TLS)
nodes.description: Authenticates devices, manages pairing codes, routes commands to connected runtimes over WSS, maintains event log, owns PolicyEngine and rate limiter.

nodes.label: PolicyEngine
nodes.description: Layered permission evaluator: CRITICAL safety → session grants → persistent project/global policies → defaults. Wraps PermissionEngine with SQLite-backed PolicyStore.

nodes.label:
PolicyStore
(SQLite)
nodes.description: Versioned SQLite tables: permission_policies and policy_audit_log. Schema migrated automatically on open. Shares the same database file as ControlPlaneStore.

nodes.label:
WSS
WebSocket
nodes.description: Mutual-auth WebSocket channel. Device authenticates with token+session_id+generation. Frame replay protection via timestamp window (60s). Heartbeat timeout 60s.

nodes.label:
LocalRuntime
(FastAPI)
nodes.description: Handles runtime.* and file.* commands from control plane. Validates workspace roots, streams file windows, paginates directories, routes agent commands to AgentManager.

nodes.label: AgentManager
nodes.description: Manages agent session lifecycle (IDLE→STARTING→RUNNING→STOPPED). Debounces output streams, tracks session generations to drop stale events, acquires workspace locks.

nodes.label:
WorkspaceLock
Manager
nodes.description: Shared READ / exclusive WRITE lock manager. Detects directory hierarchy overlaps. Session-scoped automatic release on stop.

nodes.label: AgentSupervisor
nodes.description: Monitors agent health snapshots. Invokes loop detector on output/tool events. Publishes AGENT_BLOCKED event when suspected loop detected.

nodes.label: LoopDetector
nodes.description: Deterministic loop detection: repeated commands, repeated errors, 2-step and 3-step oscillations. Emits LoopEvidence with loop_type and sample.

nodes.label:
Agent Adapters
(Generic CLI / Cursor / Codex
Jules / Antigravity)
nodes.description: Adapter per AI agent type. Launches subprocess, streams stdout/stderr as AGENT_OUTPUT events, handles tool call events, cleans up process tree on stop.

nodes.label:
Agent Process
(subprocess)
nodes.description: The actual AI coding agent process (e.g., antigravity, cursor, codex). Launched by adapter with sanitized environment.

nodes.label:
Resilience
(Circuit Breaker
Retry / Rate Limit)
nodes.description: Circuit breaker (CLOSED/OPEN/HALF_OPEN), exponential retry with jitter, sliding window rate limiter, idempotency store, task executor with deduplication.

nodes.label:
Metrics
& Health
nodes.description: In-process MetricsRegistry with event counters, latency histograms, and health check endpoints (/health/live, /health/ready).

nodes.label:
SQLite DB
(devices + sessions
+ policies + audit)
nodes.description: Single WAL-mode SQLite file: devices, bot_state, telegram_updates, permission_policies, policy_audit_log, schema_meta. All tables share one connection.

nodes.label:
File System
& Git
nodes.description: Workspace files accessed via bounded preview, paginated directory listing, binary detection. Task verifier uses Git diff + file snapshots.

nodes.label:
Redaction
& Security
nodes.description: Centralized regex redactor for API keys (sk-, ghp_, AKIA), PEM headers, Authorization tokens, sensitive file paths. Applied to all outgoing Telegram messages.
